deploy-bot: /deploy config-only --name weight-cap-tighten --changes "routing.max_fanout=3; batching.window_ms=20; timeouts.request_ms=11000" --canary 3%:10m,25%:10m --window 03:00-04:00 UTC

priya: model pin? ensure we lock to inference-1.4 variant.

priya: obs: I'll watch p95 and kvcache_evictions for first 20m. rollback if p95 > 400ms for 2 windows or error_rate >0.8%.

deploy-bot: canary started at 8160000010 3%.

priya: 8m in: metrics stable, small uptick in kvcache evictions for one dev tenant.

noah: release note posted: 'config: weight-cap-tighten — max fanout 3, 20ms batch window, 11s timeout; model pinned inference-1.4'. closing thread.
